hypotheses.name: Typed translation
hypotheses.statement: A claim cannot change physical, informational, normative, spiritual, or metaphorical type without an explicit mapping and evidence rule.

hypotheses.name: Conserved physical exchange
hypotheses.statement: Diffeomorphism-invariant coupled sectors exchange energy-momentum through equal-and-opposite currents.

hypotheses.name: Irreversibility budget
hypotheses.statement: Consequential actions consume a declared reversibility budget; increasing irreversibility requires stronger evidence, authority, and remedy.
hypotheses.test: action classifier maps impact to approval and recovery controls

hypotheses.name: Provenance-weighted belief
hypotheses.statement: Confidence grows with independent calibrated evidence and falls with shared-source dependence, counterevidence, and expiry.
hypotheses.test: source graph changes effective support when roots are duplicated

hypotheses.name: Agency under finite resources
hypotheses.statement: Claims of autonomy must include compute, energy, time, permissions, uncertainty, interruption, and recovery budgets.
hypotheses.test: benchmark report is invalid when any budget is absent

hypotheses.name: Integration without erasure
hypotheses.statement: Coordination preserves provenance, dissent, and identity boundaries unless legitimate consent and law support a change.
hypotheses.test: handoff preserves owner, dissent, and reversible checkpoint

hypotheses.name: No free phenomenology
hypotheses.statement: A psyche or consciousness term enters empirical science only with an operational variable, uncertainty model, null, observable, and falsifier.
hypotheses.test: term registry rejects named-but-unmeasured psyche tensors

hypotheses.name: Diversity-redundancy frontier
hypotheses.statement: Additional agents add value only when independent error reduction exceeds coordination, latency, and correlated-source costs.
